label: The actual contingents' joint absence by withholding, under the creator reading
description: Under the creator reading, the power for the joint absence is realized by withholding: the abstention structure of ST I q.104 a.3 ad 1 and ad 3 (annihilation would be 'a mere cessation of His action'; navigation only). Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. With P5 the holder is a two-way giver in the withholding form and not a fixed giver (controls, law 6); with the withheld-giving bridge it yields the transfer's conclusion without the transfer premise.
